scope: Standalone MTerm local engineering runtime; no Desktop Commander cloud, subscription, hosted analytics or proprietary server copying. Security-preserving differences stay explicit.

statusDefinitions.partial_alias: Exact name exposed with partial local behavior; not full parity.
statusDefinitions.native_partial: Comparable native operation exists; upstream name/schema or behavior differs.
statusDefinitions.missing: No verified standalone equivalent for this contract.
statusDefinitions.excluded_external: Vendor-hosted feature not required under local-only scope.

tools.name: get_config
tools.gap: Effective scoped preferences; no cloud telemetry. Complete current configuration/UI contract not established.

tools.name: set_config_value
tools.gap: Explicit config-write authority; cannot expand owner roots, executable ceilings or enable telemetry. Compare every supported preference and concurrent reload.

tools.name: read_file
tools.gap: Text ranges/tail and read-only BOM-marked UTF-16LE covered by earlier differential fixtures; URL, image, Excel, PDF, DOCX, preview options and additional encodings remain open.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.gap: Bounded mixed success text batches; image/office output, upstream limit and format differential tests remain open.

tools.name: write_file
tools.gap: Guarded text rewrite/append; explicit authority; office creation/structured writes not implemented in standalone alias.

tools.name: write_pdf
tools.gap: Local PDF creation, insertion/deletion and verification need an owner-approved local document implementation; no hosted renderer.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.gap: Idempotent nested directory creation; compare current errors, symlinks and cancellation.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.gap: Bounded recursive listing and explicit partial diagnostics; compare 0.3.4 formatting/depth/preview behavior.

tools.name: move_file
tools.gap: No-overwrite regular-file moves; directory and cross-device moves remain open; preserve version/no-overwrite safeguards.

tools.name: start_search
tools.gap: Bounded synchronous case-insensitive literal search; upstream asynchronous ownership, regex/globs, context lines, case options, structured document search and early termination not qualified.

tools.name: get_more_search_results
tools.gap: Requires bounded owned search session and stable result paging.

tools.name: stop_search
tools.gap: Requires actual asynchronous cancellation and cleanup, not a simulated completed-session stop.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.gap: Requires bounded per-session inventory and eviction.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.gap: Scoped text/directory metadata; office sheet metadata, formats and cross-platform behavior remain open.

tools.name: edit_block
tools.gap: Exact text replacement with match count; no fuzzy matching, XML or spreadsheet range edits in standalone alias.

tools.name: start_process
tools.gap: Scoped executable/argv and owned session IDs, not upstream PID/shell command/readiness behavior; retain executable gates.

tools.name: read_process_output
tools.gap: Sequence-based bounded event polling; line offsets/tail, prompt detection and encoding equivalence remain open.

tools.name: interact_with_process
tools.gap: Bounded input to owned session; upstream wait-for-prompt and interactive fidelity remain open.

tools.name: force_terminate
tools.gap: Stops owned sessions; require identity-safe upstream adapter and process-tree differential tests.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.gap: Owned session inventory and budgets; compare PID/status/retention contract.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.gap: System-wide inventory absent in standalone. Implement bounded local metadata, redact command secrets, and preserve host authorization.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.gap: No arbitrary-PID standalone kill. Require separate explicit host authority, exact PID identity and protected-process denial; do not widen existing owned-session policy.

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.gap: New local retained-window call counts, failures and duration; not lifetime/account/billing statistics. No external tracking.

tools.name: get_recent_tool_calls
tools.gap: New per-tool/time/count filters over bounded session metadata, no raw payloads or persistence. Persistent opt-in history/rotation remains open.

tools.name: give_feedback_to_desktop_commander
tools.gap: Vendor-hosted feedback form and telemetry excluded; optional MTerm local issue/report export is a separate feature, not a required vendor call.

additional.note: Retain DCP-001–008, supported package installs and Windows/macOS/Linux execution evidence; no automatic unpinned update.

additional.note: Hosted README documents devices/account controls. Local registry, local liveness and exact owned-agent stop remain product requirements where applicable; no vendor pairing account, external relay or subscription.

additional.note: Do not reproduce proprietary cloud internals or require third-party subscriptions. Existing independently authorized MTerm bridge is separate and not weakened.

acceptance: Full local parity requires per-operation differential fixtures against pinned upstream logic or documented contracts, intentional safety deviations reviewed, package/runtime/client verification and supported platforms. Old 48-gap ledger and release gates are unchanged; zero closure credit from this inventory.
